description: Search and discover Croatian companies in the Sudski Registar using flexible filtering criteria such as partial/fuzzy name, street address, house number, house sub-number (podbroj), city, county (županija), inception date range, NACE/NKD industry activity code prefix, legal status, or legal proceedings (e.g. likvidacija, stečaj). Returns up to 50 matching records with basic entity profile summaries. RULES: Never invent company names, addresses, or filters. If search criteria are empty, interview the user with clarifying questions before calling this tool.

house_subnumber.description: Optional house sub-number / podbroj (e.g., A, B, 1/2)

inception_date_from.description: Optional lower bound for company inception/foundation date (inclusive, format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY)

inception_date_to.description: Optional upper bound for company inception/foundation date (inclusive, format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY)

name.description: Optional name of the company (fuzzy search)

proceeding.description: Optional legal proceeding / status (e.g., likvidacija, stečaj)

street.description: Optional street name (e.g., Ilica, Radnička cesta)

name: search_companies
